WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: emotionally brittle
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene are much more susceptible to breaking under pressure, and they will spend much more time in mental breakdowns than the average person.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: immaculate
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce less filth than the average person.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: reserved
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene keep their problems to themselves rather than discussing their issues with someone else.
